summary: Join our expert-led training on AI in Climate Risk Assessment. Equip yourself with essential skills to tackle climate challenges and drive impactful change.
lede: AI in climate risk assessment helps sustainability, risk, planning and finance professionals evaluate hazards and understand potential impacts. The course covers using climate data to model floods, droughts, heatwaves and storms, assess exposure and vulnerability, and compare future scenarios. Learners also practise interpreting uncertainty and model limitations, applying human oversight, and communicating findings to support planning and investment decisions.
audienceIntro: This course is tailored for professionals who assess, manage, or respond to climate risk. It is ideal for those looking to enhance their capability in this critical area.
audience: Disaster risk reduction and resilience practitioners
Policy analysts and public sector decision-makers
modules: Introduction to AI in Climate Risk Assessment
Assessing Exposure and Vulnerability with AI
AI in Climate Risk for Finance and Investment
Integrating AI Climate Risk into Planning and Policy
Risks, Biases, and Limits of AI Models
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of climate change concepts and be familiar with general principles of risk assessment. Experience in data analysis is beneficial but not required.
